The '''R-Series Voice Box Adaptor''' was a peripheral system manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. Compatible with any of Industrial Automaton's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] in the [[R1-series astromech droid/Legends|R1]] to [[R5-series astromech droid|R5]] range, the adaptor reprogrammed the droid's language. Supported languages included [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]], [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]], and [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]].<ref name="GFT" /> [[R3-K8]], an [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series]] droid assigned to the ''[[FarStar]]'', was equipped with a Voice Box Adaptor that was programmed for Basic to allow it to communicate with the hangar control room supervisor.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>
